import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_county_unemployment_median_income.xlsx', sheet_name='Unemployment Med HH Income', header=None)
header_row = None
for i in range(10):
    if 'FIPS_Code' in df.iloc[i].values:
        header_row = i
        break
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
df = df.iloc[header_row+1:].copy()

al_income = float(df[df['Area_Name'] == 'Alabama']['Median_Household_Income_2022'].values[0])
wa_income = float(df[df['Area_Name'] == 'Washington']['Median_Household_Income_2022'].values[0])
result = 'Washington' if wa_income > al_income else 'Alabama'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_county_unemployment_median_income.xlsx', sheet_name='Unemployment Med HH Income', header=None)
header_row = None
for i in range(10):
    if 'FIPS_Code' in df.iloc[i].values:
        header_row = i
        break
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
df = df.iloc[header_row+1:].copy()

us_row = df[df['FIPS_Code'] == '00000'].iloc[0]
years = [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023]
rates = {str(y): float(us_row[f'Unemployment_rate_{y}']) for y in years}
result = max(rates, key=rates.get)
